items: USPS to add weekly fuel surcharge. Starting in January 2027, USPS will apply a fuel surcharge to domestic Ground Advantage, Priority Mail, Priority Mail Express and Parcel Select shipments. It will be a percentage of base postage, updated weekly from diesel and jet fuel prices, and negotiated contracts may have customized applicability language.

UPS Small Business Rates gain fuel surcharge. From Dec. 21, 2026, UPS raises Small Business Rates 4.5% and applies a 5% fuel surcharge to all SBR shipments, domestic and international, for a combined increase of about 9.7%. The Additional Handling minimum billable weight also rises from 40 to 50 lb, and the program was previously advertised as including fuel and delivery area surcharges.

UPS sets Nov. 1 for EU Product Identifier. The UPS developer portal now gives an effective date of Nov. 1, 2026 for the EU Product Identifier requirement on certain B2C shipments entering the EU; the earlier notice had no date. The notice does not say which product categories are covered or what happens to shipments without PID data.
